jobs.title: Customer Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
INTRODUCTION

Hi, I'm Al https://www.linkedin.com/in/al-stolz/ and I lead Customer Operations at Candid. As a team, we’re primarily responsible for delivering valuable outcomes with and for our customers. Prior to Candid, I led teams at McKinsey & Co for 5 years, based in both NYC and Sydney, Australia. I started my career as an M&A lawyer at Allens, a top Australian law firm.

We’re hiring for outstanding folks on my team, and I want to tell you a bit about how we think about this role, because it's different from what you'll find at most companies - and that difference is very intentional.

At Candid, our model is one where a single, empowered individual is responsible for delivering outcomes with and for customers. Our internal name for this role is “Valkyrie” and it originally evolved out of necessity. In the early days of Candid, as with many startups, it was impossible to have separate people owning all the things required to help customers win; one person had to integrate across all of it. What we found is that this isn’t just a startup constraint - it is an incredibly effective way to organize ourselves. A single, empowered owner who can move fluidly across functional boundaries will outperform a team of specialists nearly every time, especially in a domain as complex and fragmented as revenue cycle management.

As we've scaled to ~200 people, we've intentionally preserved that model. We've split off certain functionally specialized supporting teams - such as Customer Support, Implementation, Forward Deployed Engineering, and Training & Enablement - but the Valkyrie remains the single-point owner of customer outcomes. The anti-pattern we actively resist is the substance-light CSM role that's mostly about relationship management and renewal motions. To be effective at Candid, you have to be willing and able to operate at the lowest tactical level - iterating on prompts for agent phone calls to navigate payer IVRs, debugging detailed syntax errors in EDI rejections with a clearinghouse, mapping hundreds of fields between a legacy system and ours - and then zoom out to shape the strategic direction of an account. Some might describe that work as unglamorous, but the best people on this team relish doing it, because that's where the valuable outcomes live.

The shape of person who thrives here tends to be a low-ego, high-slope generalist. They are resourceful, laser-focused on value delivery, and wired to expand into unowned space rather than wait for scope to be handed to them. This is not a role where your responsibilities are neatly defined and bounded. Valkyries see what needs to happen and make it happen, often before anyone asks. When you spot a gap between teams, an unowned customer problem, or an emerging product opportunity, the expectation is that you move toward it.

That bet - that a scrappy, resourceful generalist given space and expansive ownership will outperform a specialist - has paid off at every stage of Candid's growth. I'm looking for people who will keep proving it right.




THE ROLE

Candid Health is looking to hire multiple Customer Strategy & Operations team members in 2026! Over the past year, this team has grown significantly, and we’re excited to bring on new talent to help drive that momentum forward and support our continued expansion.

In this role, you will own a portfolio of current customers and will be responsible for ensuring that they achieve world-class revenue cycle outcomes. This ownership can span the entire customer journey: you may be involved in scoping a late-stage deal and helping to close it, own the implementation of a new group with Candid, or you may focus on optimizing established accounts through deep-dive data analysis and workflow redesign, as well as deep partnership with Engineering, Product and Design colleagues.

You will work directly with customers to understand their challenges (e.g., root causing denials issues, digging into workflow gaps), as well as cross-functionally with other internal teams at Candid to develop solutions.

This team is at the tip of the spear working with customers helping to make medical billing less painful for everyone involved. If you are excited about what we are building, we’d love to speak with you and see if there is a fit across the team!




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Your main goal is to maximize the value Candid delivers—helping ensure a higher portion of claims get paid, more quickly, and with less effort. Depending on the needs of your portfolio, your focus will include:

 - You’ll interact closely with our current customers, developing intuition around their biggest pain points and thinking of creative ways to address them.

 - You’ll own significant business outcomes and be responsible for driving key metrics for the company, including minimizing "time-to-live" for new partners and maximizing collection rates for existing ones.

 - You will be responsible for digging into data (i.e. performing analysis on claims metrics) to identify the root cause of customer issues and provide data informed recommendations for solutions.

 - You will own the end-to-end implementation roadmap for new customers, ensuring a seamless platform launch and driving the conversion of contracted ARR into recognized revenue.

 - The solutions that you help develop may be both operational (e.g., workflow (re-)design) and/or product-oriented (e.g., automation of manual workflows). You will lead deep-dive discovery sessions to navigate complex workflow requirements, partnering closely with Forward Engineering to translate customer needs into scalable product solutions.

 - Your main goal will be to maximize the value that Candid delivers for our customers (i.e., helping ensure a higher portion of claims get paid, more quickly, and with less effort).

 - You will work closely with other Candid teams, including our RCM, Customer Support, Product, Design and Engineering teams to help solve our customers' most valuable and painful problems.

 - You’ll play a critical role in shaping our company culture and help make this the best place we’ve ever worked.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 1-3 years of experience

 - You have a demonstrated track record of expansively owning and driving key business outcomes on high-performing teams.

 - You take pride in your craft and enjoy maintaining a high quality bar, but also believe that “done is better than perfect” and have good intuition around which corners are okay to cut and which aren’t.

 - You are a systems thinker who instinctively maps out dependencies and understands how early configuration choices impact the long-term success of the customer.

 - You enjoy identifying problems and designing product features to address them, and aren’t shy about rolling up your sleeves and getting the work done in the meantime.

 - You have a track record of scaling processes and operations.

 - You’re a clear and concise communicator; you enjoy the challenge of explaining complicated ideas in simple terms, both in-person and in writing.

 - [Optionally] You have experience in healthcare technology and/or healthcare financial services




PAY TRANSPARENCY

The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $120,000 - $145,000 USD. The listed range is a guideline from Pave https://www.pave.com/ data, and the actual base salary may be modified based on factors including job-related skills, experience/qualifications, interview performance, market data, etc. Total compensation for this position may also include equity, sales incentives (for sales roles), and employee benefits. Given Candid Health’s funding and size, we heavily value the potential upside from equity in our compensation package. Further note that Candid Health has minimal hierarchy and titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles.

Please note: we are looking for employees to join our in-person culture at one of our offices (Denver, San Francisco, or New York). Our ideal weekly schedule is 4 days in-office and 1 day working remotely. Depending on the focus of your role, travel may be up to 25%.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Strategic Finance Manager to drive analytical decision-making to support Candid Health’s growth. In this role, you won't just handle financial planning—you will partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, Operations and company leadership to drive business execution and growth.

 

You will be responsible for owning business planning & forecasting, analyzing our unit economics including margin / profitability, increasing efficiency and scaling of our GTM motion, and optimizing our capital allocation decisions to maximize growth.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Strategic Planning & Analysis: Own P&L forecasting, including annual plans, quarterly forecasts, and monthly reporting.

 - Unit Economics & Pricing: Deep dive into our gross margins and define CAC/LTV by customer segment.

 - Capital Allocation: Conduct rigorous analysis on TAM, new product opportunities, partnerships, and M&A to ensure we are deploying capital toward the highest-leverage outcomes.

 - AI-Enabled Forecasting: Move beyond manual Excel updates. Leverage AI-driven FP&A tools / systems to automate variance analysis and rolling forecasts, allowing you to focus on the strategic questions rather than tracking performance.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - Experience: 4-6 years of finance experience (strategic finance, investment banking, and/or private equity), including experience owning forecasting and analytical decision making at a high growth company.

 - Analytical Powerhouse: You are driven by innate curiosity to get to “the why” and to understand root cause and are comfortable leveraging big data sets to inform decision-making. You have high proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, but you are also comfortable using SQL to pull your own data.

 - Communication: You can translate dense financial data into a compelling story for non-finance stakeholders. You don’t just present options - you have a point of view on what action should be taken and you’re not afraid to share it. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise with practical operational leadership and is comfortable partnering with executives on long-term strategy.

 - The "Multiplier" Mindset: You are a "player-coach" who wants to build the templates and systems yourself. You proactively look for ways to use AI and automation to make our financial planning process 10x faster and more accurate.

 


PAY TRANSPARENCY

The estimated starting annual salary range for this position is $180,000 - $200,000 USD. The listed range is a guideline from Pave https://www.pave.com/ data, and the actual base salary may be modified based on factors including job-related skills, experience/qualifications, interview performance, market data, etc. Total compensation for this position may also include equity, sales incentives (for sales roles), and employee benefits. Given Candid Health’s funding and size, we heavily value the potential upside from equity in our compensation package. Further note that Candid Health has minimal hierarchy and titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles.




LOCATION

We are an in-person culture. We believe the best work happens when we are in the same room and our ideal weekly schedule is 4 days working from our San Francisco office and 1 day working remotely.

That bet - that a scrappy, resourceful generalist given space and expansive ownership will outperform a specialist - has paid off at every stage of Candid's growth. I'm looking for people who will keep proving it right.



The Role - New Graduate Customer Strategy and Operations

Candid Health is hiring multiple New Graduate Customer Strategy & Operations team members to join our team in 2027. This is a new grad role — we're looking for sharp, driven people coming out of top undergraduate programs who want real ownership over real outcomes from day one.

We're fixing one of the most broken and expensive parts of US healthcare: medical billing. Healthcare providers spend over $280B a year on administrative overhead just to get paid by insurance. We're building software backed by best-in-class data science and AI to automate that complexity so providers get paid more, faster, and with less effort. We were in Y Combinator (W20) and are backed by Sixth Street, Oak HC/FT, 8VC, and First Round Capital.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across the customer life-cycle. You'll own a portfolio of healthcare provider customers and be responsible for their success on the Candid platform. That means digging into claims data to root-cause problems, leading implementations from contract to go-live, building processes that scale, and partnering with our engineering and product teams to turn customer pain points into product features and AI-powered automations. You'll work cross-functionally with nearly every team at Candid — RCM, Support, Product, Design, Engineering, and Sales — and you'll be the voice of the customer inside the building.

This is not a rotational program where you observe for a year. You will have customers, metrics, and outcomes that are yours. But you won't be thrown in alone, you'll be mentored by experienced operators and leaders who have built this function from scratch, and you'll join a cohort of other new grads going through the same ramp together. Our talent comes from top companies (e.g., MBB, Lyft, Palantir, Amazon, Investment Banking) and you will get their mentorship and you'll ramp alongside a cohort of other new grads who are just as driven as you are. We invest heavily in developing our people because the problems we're solving require it, and because we want Candid to be the place that launched your career.



Examples of What You'll Do

 - Own a portfolio of customer accounts and drive their retention, expansion, and success on the Candid platform

 - Dig into claims data to identify why denials are happening, where revenue is leaking, and what needs to change, then build the action plan and execute it

 - Lead end-to-end implementations for new customers: map their workflows, configure the platform, coordinate across internal teams, and get them live

 - Partner with Product and Forward Deployed Engineering to translate recurring customer problems into product features, workflow automations, and AI agents

 - Communicate directly with customers,  on calls, in writing, and in person, as their primary strategic partner at Candid

 - Build and document processes that don't exist yet: SOPs, templates, playbooks, and systems that let this team scale

 - Work cross-functionally every day with RCM, Customer Support, Product, Design, Engineering, and Sales

 - Identify opportunities to automate manual workflows using AI tools and advocate for building them into the product

Who You Are

 - You are graduating either fall 2026 or Spring 2027 (or recently graduated) with a Bachelor's degree from a top undergraduate program

 - You have a track record of owning outcomes, not just completing assignments: in internships, research, clubs, athletics, your own business, or food service work

 - You're analytical: you are excited about data and drawing insights from data

 - You're a builder: when you see a broken process, your instinct is to fix the system, not work around it

 - You communicate clearly and concisely in writing, on calls, and in a room full of people who know more than you

 - You're coachable: you actively seek feedback, are introspective, and make changes

 - You have grit: you've done hard things and didn't quit when they got uncomfortable:  competitive athletics, demanding coursework, a job, starting something from scratch

 - You're excited about AI and comfortable using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Copilot to move faster and build things

 - Healthcare experience is a plus but not required, what matters is curiosity and the drive to learn

Example Majors We Love, Not Required

Computer Science, Economics, Pre-Med (Human Biology, Biology, Neuroscience), Healthcare Management, Public Policy, Global Health, Finance, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Statistics, Applied Math, Systems Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Entrepreneurship

Why Candid

 - Real ownership from day one. You'll have customers, metrics, and deliverables that are yours

 - Mentorship built in. You'll be coached by experienced leaders who have built this team from the ground up, and you'll ramp alongside a cohort of other new grads

 - Shape the product. Your customer insights directly inform what our engineering team builds next including AI agents and automations

 - Work that matters. We help healthcare providers treat opioid addiction, expand access to mental health care, support women's health, and more. The billing problem we solve is the thing standing between providers and patients

 - World-class team and backers. YC W20, Sixth Street, Oak HC/FT, 8VC, First Round Capital. You'll work alongside people from McKinsey, Palantir, Lyft and other top companies

 - Compensation: $90,000-$120,000 base salary + equity with meaningful upside given Candid's growth stage

 - Location: Denver, San Francisco, or New York — 4 days in-office, 1 day remote. Travel up to 25% is possible.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Strategic Finance GTM Lead to drive decision-making behind Candid Health’s GTM motion. In this role, you will be a senior thought leader to our enterprise selling motion in partnership with our Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Leadership team. Success will be determined by your direct impact on business results, specifically your ability to grow our topline in multiples over the coming years.

 

This role is unique: a combination of finance and revenue operations responsibilities. You will own GTM business planning and forecasting, define pipeline and success metrics, and provide insights into channel and portfolio-level performance and unit economics. You will also lead deal desk and pricing, design compensation plans, and partner with senior leadership on growth capital decisions to maximize growth.



What you’ll be doing

Own end-to-end GTM planning, strategy design and execution through multiple interdependent responsibilities:

 - Strategic Planning & Analysis: Own forecasting for bookings and sales capacity planning driving annual plans, quarterly forecasts, and monthly reporting.

 - Deal desk & pricing: Building pricing frameworks and strategies to optimize our unit economics vs volume growth.

 - Metric design and success measurement: own metric design / definition, goaling and grading, performance evaluation covering: channel and function level ROI / payback, entire Sales pipeline (TOF → BOF) inclusive of lead generation reach and stage win rate / conversion, customer segmentation, marketing metrics / performance

 - Insights analysis and deep dives: Run deep dives and analyses into funnel, channel and overall GTM performance. Identify key friction points, work with corresponding stakeholders to design & implement solutions and measure results

 - Build excellent, scalable processes: build systematic approach to continuously evaluate strategy and execution: run pipeline reviews, deal assessments and corresponding corrective actions

 - Executive communication: own end-to-end narrative for GTM performance. Work with the Head of Finance and senior leadership team to build and executive core GTM strategies.

 - AI-Enabled Forecasting: Leverage AI-driven tools / systems to automate variance analysis and rolling forecasts, allowing you to focus on the strategic questions rather than tracking performance.



Who you are 

 - Experience: 6-10 years of finance experience (strategic finance, investment banking, and/or private equity), including prior experience managing GTM finance for a multi-channel enterprise (B2B) selling motion.

 - Analytical Powerhouse: You are driven by innate curiosity to get to “the why” and to understand root cause and are comfortable leveraging big data sets to inform decision-making. You have high proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, but you are also comfortable using SQL to pull your own data.

 - Communication: You can translate dense financial data into a compelling story for non-finance stakeholders. You don’t just present options - you have a point of view on what action should be taken and you’re not afraid to share it. The ideal candidate combines deep financial expertise with practical operational leadership and is comfortable partnering with executives on long-term strategy.

jobs.title: Security GRC Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT CANDID HEALTH

In simple terms, healthcare in the U.S. has a massive, invisible problem behind the scenes: getting doctors paid by insurance companies is notoriously complicated. Insurance rules are constantly changing, and every bill (or "claim") requires mountains of paperwork. When mistakes happen, bills get rejected, patients end up with unexpected charges, and healthcare providers waste billions of dollars and countless hours on administrative bureaucracy instead of focusing on patient care. 

 

That is where Candid Health steps in. Founded by former Palantir leaders who experienced these pain points firsthand, we are building the modern financial backbone for American healthcare. Instead of relying on decades-old legacy software or attempting to patch broken systems with superficial tools, we've rebuilt the underlying infrastructure from the ground up.

 

Our core product is an autonomous Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) platform. Powered by AI agents and a configurable rules engine, the platform unifies clinical, billing, and insurance data into a single smart system. It acts like an intelligent, automated back-office that handles complex medical claims from start to finish—submitting them accurately on the first pass, cutting down administrative costs, and dramatically increasing cash flow for healthcare providers.

 

Today, we are trusted by over 200 fast-growing healthcare organizations—from digital health innovators to large enterprise medical groups—processing billions in claims annually. Backed by top investors like Sixth Street Growth, Oak HC/FT, 8VC, and Y Combinator, Candid Health recently raised a $120 million Series D to fuel the AI-driven transformation of healthcare payments and eliminate administrative friction for good.






ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Security GRC Lead to build our first in-house GRC program from the ground up. In this role, you won't just write policies or collect manual screenshots in spreadsheets; you will treat compliance as an engineering and data problem.

You will build automated evidence pipelines, implement compliance-as-code, and establish continuous controls monitoring across our GCP infrastructure, identity systems, and CI/CD pipelines. You will turn point-in-time audits into a continuous compliance telemetry system that keeps our platform secure, resilient, and audit-ready at all times.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1) Compliance Automation & Engineering

 - Develop automated scripts and API integrations to collect compliance evidence directly from system sources instead of collecting manual screenshots.

 - Write and deploy infrastructure-as-code and policy enforcement rules to enforce security baselines automatically.

 - Maintain live compliance dashboards and alerts that flag configuration drift or policy violations in real time.

 - Partnering with Legal on Medicare and Medicaid compliance

 - Partnering closely with legal and finance teams on future due diligence and compliance projects

2) Framework Mapping & Control Architecture

 - Convert regulatory, security, and industry standards (SOC 2, HiTrust, PCI, HIPAA)  into clear, testable technical controls.

 - Map single technical controls across multiple overlapping frameworks to eliminate redundant work.

 - Work alongside DevOps and Software Engineering teams to build compliance controls directly into CI/CD pipelines without slowing down delivery.

3) Risk Management & Audits

 - Lead technical audit readiness and external audit engagements using programmatic evidence pipelines.

 - Automate vendor risk management workflows and API-driven vendor evaluations.

 - Build continuous risk tracking tools fed by live vulnerability telemetry and identity logs rather than static quarterly surveys.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years in a technical security role, such as Security Engineering, Cloud Security, or Technical GRC.

 - Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, SQL and hands on experience interacting with APIs, parsing logs, and querying databases.

 - Hands-on experience with at least one primary cloud platform, GCP Preferred and Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform

 - Deep familiarity with core frameworks such as SOC 1/2, PCI, NIST, and/or HITRUST.

 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and container environments (Docker/Kubernetes).




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CRISC, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or CCSP.

 - Experience with Policy-as-Code engines

 - HITRUST experience

 - Background in software development, DevOps, or platform engineering.

 - Experience with modern continuous compliance platforms (e.g., Vanta, Drata, Anecdotes).





OUR VALUES

We spend at least as much time with our coworkers as we do with our closest friends + family - if we intend to do the most important + challenging work of our lives, it’s important that these folks energize us, support us, inspire us, and push us to do our best work. This is what you can expect of your teammates at Candid (in no particular order):

 - We put our customers first

 - We take care of each other and ourselves

 - We anchor on outcomes and work relentlessly and creatively to achieve them

 - We collectively prioritize building a diverse and inclusive workspace

 - We believe humility is our greatest strength

 - We are candid, kind, and committed

 - We strive to be the most prepared person in the room

 - We are truth seekers
